children: Vertiv Holdings Co. (VRT) filed a Form 8K - Regulation FD Disclosure - with the U.S Securities and Exchange Commission on September 02, 2026.

The following information is furnished pursuant to Item 7.01, "Regulation FD Disclosure." This information, including Exhibit 99.1 attached hereto, shall not be deemed filed for purposes of Section 18 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended (the "Exchange Act"), or incorporated by reference into any filing under the Securities Act of 1933, as amended, or the Exchange Act, except as shall be expressly set forth by specific reference in such filing. On September 2, 2026, the Company issued a press release announcing that Buyer had entered into the Acquisition Agreement. The press release is furnished as Exhibit 99.1 to this Form 8-K.
The full text of this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1674101/000119312526379306/d472406d8k.htm
Any exhibits and associated documents for this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1674101/000119312526379306/0001193125-26-379306-index.htm
Public companies must file a Form 8-K, or current report, with the SEC generally within four days of any event that could materially affect a company's financial position or the value of its shares.
